scam_samples.text: You have already completed 2 interview rounds. To finalize your offer letter, please transfer USD 120 for background verification today. Do not share this with anyone.
Last seat left. Pay 10000 LKR now to keep your slot or we will give it to another candidate.
Send your OTP and bank details immediately or your onboarding will be cancelled within 1 hour.

safe_samples.text: Hi, thanks for applying. Are you available for a 30-minute interview tomorrow at 3pm? We can meet on Google Meet.
The role is Hybrid in Colombo. Salary range will be discussed after the technical round. Looking forward to speaking with you.
Please bring your updated CV and portfolio link to the interview. No payment is required at any stage.
